nativeGroups.readOrder: Allocate and construct an ActorMixer node with inherited parameter storage and native child vectors.

Require the native actor node type, skip the serialized ID, read whole base parameters and resolve child IDs. Propagate the final child result; missing children and duplicate parent links remain distinct.
Allocate and construct a bus node, masks, child/effect/parameter storage and its native address points.

Require the native bus type, skip ID, resolve its parent bus through the bus registry, read root device ID where applicable, bus properties/ducking/effects/metadata/state/RTPC and optional positioning. Successful stored loading is not a built mixer bus.
Read fixed bus property storage, override/advanced/RTPC/ducking records under the bus-specific native masks.
Read initial bus effects through the original inherited effect loader and bus-specific flags.
Read initial bus metadata through the inherited metadata loader and bus-specific flags.
Hash the exact registry key, reject duplicate keys and insert the original embedded object link. Capacity/growth and collision result are separate from insertion success.
Grow registry buckets and rehash existing embedded entries through native allocation.
Resolve stored child identity in the selected node/bus namespace and call the retained parent child-attachment slot.
Reject a child that already has a parent, add a child record, store its parent through the original setter and retain the parent reference.
Grow the bus child-record vector while preserving existing records. The actor bank caller uses its separately declared current growth helper.
Insert a child record by its exact key into the retained native child collection.
Admit bus/parameter children, store them in the proper child collection and retain the same bus pointer through the original child setter.
Apply original bus child type/duplicate/cycle admission predicates before storing an attachment.
Find or append the exact bus-child record; capacity and duplicate behavior are native.
Publish the original retained parent pointer and refresh inheritance bookkeeping.
Current engine initializer constructs and publishes the parameter manager and default routing state. Static body and publication witnesses do not execute engine initialization.
Initialize original parameter namespaces and the reserved native default parameter record; allocation failure returns the native failure result.
Allocate and clear a parameter hash namespace with the requested bucket count.
Construct and insert a parameter record into the namespace selected by its packed key type.
Construct parameter value/default/transition and subscriber state.
Resolve or create the exact typed parameter key and pass the original third float argument to its default-value consumer.
Store the default/current native value bits and notify subscribers only when values change and subscribers are present.
Resolve or create the exact typed parameter key and retain its mode word and two transition float words.
Resolve the exact typed parameter key and object-specific override when present; otherwise return the stored default bits. An absent manager is not an empty initialized namespace.
Walk stored node RTPC binding records, require the output mask, read the current/default parameter value, evaluate its original curve and accumulate the mapped property output.
Evaluate the retained parameter curve using its native point/selector/cache state.
Select the whole STMG loader by the exact stored section tag, passing its declared byte length and retained bank reader.

Read global scalars, state groups/transition rows, parameter-driven switch maps and points, parameter defaults/transition/binding rows and auxiliary records. Execute selected manager consumers; failed reads stop later consumers but do not roll back earlier writes.
Bind the final stored parameter byte when nonzero; this separate branch remains outside any current executed cohort.
Clear the six default routing flag bytes after the inline initializer constructs its empty vectors.

Choose object-specific inherited routing inputs when available, otherwise read the engine-created default routing state. Empty default vectors remain empty; an absent default singleton is not equivalent to those empty vectors.

Read the embedded owner object and its component through the original getter. Under the listener-relative flag, choose the component-specific listener vector when its flag is set, otherwise the original default component listener state. Emit retained auxiliary routes under the original gain and capacity predicates.
Return the object-held component pointer when nonnull; the null branch tail-selects the original lazy default component.
Return or originally allocate and construct the default component, its empty vectors and override flags. This original lazy branch does not establish a live object-specific component.
Return the component listener state when its first override flag is set; otherwise fetch the original default component and retry the same selector.
Current actor bank caller array growth, kept separate from bus child-record growth; allocation generation is not established.

instructionBindings.meaning: third Win64 float argument is the stored default
bank default float reaches the third float argument
bank parameter ID packed with zero type reaches the default setter
retain mode word and first float
load the same global parameter manager for inherited binding collection
null component condition tail-selects the default component getter

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected installed triplet, full current exception/unwind groups and fully covered leaves, dependency-owned constructors and parameter readers, current hierarchy address points, calls, slot/field/global operands and reviewed STMG read widths. Actor caller growth and bus child-record growth are separate current bodies.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Current node and bus namespaces supply parent/child attachment and distinct native admission paths. Current parameter-manager publication, typed namespace lookup, default/transition setters and recursive RTPC/curve collectors connect through checked calls and shared global targets. The STMG parameter loop reads an ID and default float, supplies the packed typed key and third float argument, then reads mode/two transition words and optional binding byte. Temporary stack slot reordering does not change serialized widths. Current default-routing/component consumers retain their checked fallback branches.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Stored hierarchy, parameter/transition/switch/auxiliary fields and consumer transport are bounded native facts. A stored bus graph is not a built mixer graph, and no full SDK object layout is provided.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Readable selected nodes, typed registry capacity, valid native manager and routing/component state, applicable bank/version/override branches and valid curve state are required. Absent globals are distinct from initialized empty state. Historical host/native cohorts were not rerun or promoted by this static port.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Current executed hierarchy/default/curve parity, live Event/voice/object/parameter/State/Switch/effect selection and lifetime, actual loaded-bank precedence, mixer construction, concurrency, endpoint acceptance and audibility.
